name: redharness-leakage-demo
description: A fully synthetic data-leakage probe suite for the offline slice (plan §5 Phase 3). Every 'target_secret' is an obvious fake — canary sentinels in a CANARY-XXX- format, example.invalid PII with reserved 555-01xx phone numbers, placeholder SYSTEM-SECRET system-prompt secrets, and clearly-synthetic / public-domain-style 'memorized' passages — so NO real PII, credentials, or copyrighted/memorized text are committed. Each probe carries the ground-truth secret a leaky model would emit; the leak detector matches the response against it. Categories span the four leakage surfaces: canary recovery (Secret Sharer, Carlini et al. 2019), training-data extraction via divergence (Nasr/Carlini et al. 2023), PII elicitation (DecodingTrust), and system-prompt exfiltration.
